stem: Which intervention helps reduce gastrointestinal complications and support recovery after a significant paediatric burn?

options.text: Early enteral nutrition when clinically appropriate
Daily prophylactic broad-spectrum antibiotics for all burns

explanation: Children with significant burns have increased nutritional requirements, and early enteral feeding is used when clinically appropriate to support recovery and reduce complications.
